exposure: maternal anemia in the first trimester
cohort: The study included 414 pregnant women (138 cases of preterm birth and 276 controls) residing in rural areas of Sardashat, Iran.
finding: Preterm birth was significantly associated with lower education levels, fewer antenatal care visits, maternal anemia in the first trimester, higher parity, premature rupture of membranes, gestational diabetes mellitus, preeclampsia, history of abortion, and maternal age.
gest_age: Gestational age was estimated through ultrasound during the first trimester to determine preterm birth status.
